title: Dave Righetti New York Yankees 1988 Donruss #93 - Set Of 2
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of two 1988 Donruss trading cards featuring Dave Righetti of the New York Yankees. These cards are part of the MLB league and are not autographed or memorabilia. They are a great addition to any baseball card collection, especially for fans of the New York Yankees or Dave Righetti. These vintage cards capture a moment in baseball history from the 1988 season.
